title: Mega Man 8
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man 8 has separate buttons for the Buster and the equipped special weapon. You can slide and charge the Buster. Tap Jump repeatedly to swim upward; underwater movement is different from earlier games.
There are no E-Tanks. Rush support comes from miniboss clears and can be called once per life. Save Rush Charger for health and weapon recovery when a late fight goes badly.

The 40 bolts are unique, permanent collectibles. You cannot buy every shop part with them, and purchases cannot be undone. This guide covers the PlayStation version used in Legacy Collection 2; Saturn-only Cut Man and Wood Man are excluded.
routeIntro: Clear the island, then Grenade → Frost → Tengu → Clown. Duo opens the second set; start Astro with charged shots, then Aqua → Sword → Search. Return for bolts requiring the later weapons.

stages.name: Opening island
stages.tip: Use Mega Ball on the crab. Hold Jump while landing on a ball to bounce higher.

items.name: Bolt 01 · hidden wall
items.text: Activate the skull lift. In the underwater passage, swim through the upper-left wall after the first ascent.

items.name: Bolt 02 · platform floor
items.text: Ride the descending chain platforms through the floor into the concealed room.

items.name: Bolt 03 · exit
items.text: Collect it before leaving the underground passage.

stages.name: Grenade Man
stages.tip: Jump the bombs and shoot between his throws. Move as the floor breaks.

items.name: Bolt 04 · falling blocks
items.text: Preserve the lower-right green block; stack a falling silver block on it, then bounce with Mega Ball.

items.name: Bolt 05 · timed platforms
items.text: Jump onto the early bomb platforms and collect it before the fuse ends.

items.name: Bolt 06 · unlit fuse
items.text: After the checkpoint, ignite the fuse to open the blocked passage.

items.name: Bolt 07 · explosion route
items.text: Take the visible bolt promptly when the platform fuse starts.

items.name: Bolt 08 · final explosion
items.text: Grab the last bolt in the exploding section and immediately return to the ladder.

items.name: Rush Cycle
items.text: Defeat the stage miniboss. The motorcycle improves ground speed and jumping.

stages.name: Frost Man

items.name: Bolt 09 · first board upper path
items.text: At the first Slide prompt, jump onto the upper passage and slide through.

items.name: Bolt 10 · first board lower path

items.name: Bolt 11 · high ledge

items.name: Bolt 12 · ice launcher
items.text: Reach the second launcher, press its button and step left onto the moving ice block.

items.name: Bolt 16 · airship ceiling

items.name: Bolt 17 · guardian exit
items.text: Catch the bolt on the ledge after defeating the airship guardian.

stages.tip: Use charged Buster or Flash Bomb first. Watch the two orbiting spheres and the incoming meteors.

items.name: Bolt 27 · collapsing tower

items.text: Collect the visible bolt while the temporary platforms are present.

items.name: Bolt 29 · second maze
items.text: Use the switches to open the lower corridor; use Tornado Hold over the high wall, then jump past the green switch to the bolt.

items.name: Bolt 30 · flooded ceiling
items.text: After the checkpoint, break the cracked ceiling in the second room, then swim up-right.

items.name: Bolt 31 · spike ball
items.text: Lift the low-right spike ball with a tornado and slide underneath.

items.name: Bolt 32 · flooded shaft
items.text: After flooding the stage, swim across the spike pit and descend the shaft; take the bolt beside the second spike platform.

items.name: Bolt 33 · ladder shaft
items.text: Replay from the checkpoint or revisit. Take the ladder route instead of swimming across the spike pit; keep left during the descent.

stages.tip: Use Water Balloon between his separations. The four early trial rooms require your first four special weapons.

items.text: Take the bolt on the floor at the beginning of the Flash Bomb room.

items.name: Bolt 35 · Thunder Claw trial
items.text: Take the low-left bolt in the third Thunder Claw room before the platforms move.

items.name: Bolt 36 · lava waterfall
items.text: After the lava waterfall, shoot the marked ceiling with Flash Bomb. Climb the ladder and collect the bolt on the upper ledge.

stages.tip: Burn his hiding shrubs with Flame Sword. Move to open ground before the missiles arrive.

items.name: Bolt 37 · foreground leaves
items.text: Look behind the leaves at the lower right of the early jungle room.

items.name: Bolt 38 · high hook
items.text: Ride Tornado Hold toward the high hook, switch to Thunder Claw, swing right and climb the ladder.

items.name: Bolt 39 · thorn plants
items.text: Burn the six thorn plants below the high-hook area.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: 40 bolts across the island, Duo and eight stages; four Rush support rewards. Make your shop choices and refill special weapons.

warning.title: Bolts are limited. Read the shop descriptions before buying.
warning.text: There are 40 bolts and more than 40 bolts’ worth of parts. Energy Saver, Super Recover and a charge upgrade are useful first-run choices. Keep a save before committing to a purchase.

sections.title: Choosing shop parts
paragraphs: Energy Saver stretches special-weapon energy. Super Recover improves supply pickups. Hyper Charge shortens Buster charging; Laser Shot changes the charged shot into a piercing beam.
Exit leaves an already-cleared stage, making bolt returns quicker. Buying every part is impossible in one save; choose the effects you will actually use.

sections.title: Wily’s tower
paragraphs: Stage 1: follow the Jump and Slide board prompts. At the pod boss, bounce Mega Ball into the pod with eyes; the plain supply pod drops weapon energy.
Stage 2: use charged Buster or Flash Bomb on the flying ship. Stage 3: use charged Buster on Bass and Astro Crush to protect against his meteor attack.
Green Devil: Flash Bomb opens the body; hit the eye when it opens with Thunder Claw or charged Buster. Reuse the weakness chain in the rematches.

Wily Machine: hit the eyes with Flash Bomb or Water Balloon and interrupt the mouth laser with ordinary shots. Capsule: use charged Buster from a safe distance, or Flame Sword when close enough. Call Rush Charger for recovery.
